items.title: Hackers Exploiting Plex Vulnerabilities in the Wild to Deploy Cryptominer Malware
items.description: Hackers are exploiting flaws in Plex Media Server to install cryptocurrency mining malware, with a researcher recording successful attacks against a honeypot on October 17, 2026. The activity follows the release of Plex2Shell, a public exploit that chains four vulnerabilities to run code without logging in. items.title: Microsoft Confirms October Windows Updates Can Break Exchange Server Email Services
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed that Windows Server security updates released on October 13, 2026, can disrupt Exchange Server email services, blocking webmail access and leaving messages undelivered. The issue affects some on-premises systems running Exchange Server 2016, Exchange Server 2019, and Exchange Server Subscription Edition.
